```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_component_bom AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_component_id,
        child_component_id,
        qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
component_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base case: find the component_id for TAB-548-GRY-00039
    SELECT 
        c.component_id as root_component_id,
        c.component_id as current_component_id,
        1 as total_qty
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: find all parent assemblies that contain this component
    SELECT 
        ch.root_component_id,
        ccb.parent_component_id as current_component_id,
        ch.total_qty * ccb.qty as total_qty
    FROM component_hierarchy ch
    JOIN current_component_bom ccb ON ch.current_component_id = ccb.child_component_id
),
current_model_bom AS (
    SELECT 
        model_id,
        component_id,
        qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
models_with_component AS (
    -- Direct usage in model BOM
    SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id
    FROM current_model_bom mb
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039'
    
    UNION
    
    -- Indirect usage through assemblies in model BOM
    SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id
    FROM current_model_bom mb
    JOIN component_hierarchy ch ON mb.component_id = ch.current_component_id
    -- Only count where the hierarchy found parent assemblies (not the root itself)
    WHERE ch.current_component_id != ch.root_component_id
      -- Also include if the model directly references an assembly that contains our component
      OR mb.component_id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT ccb.parent_component_id 
          FROM current_component_bom ccb
          JOIN component c ON ccb.child_component_id = c.component_id
          WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039'
      )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) as model_count
FROM models_with_component;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE component_tree AS (
    -- Anchor: direct children of the target component
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id
    FROM component_bom cb
    WHERE cb.child_component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039')
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find parents of parents
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id
    FROM component_bom cb
    INNER JOIN component_tree ct ON cb.child_component_id = ct.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mb.model_id)
FROM model_bom mb
WHERE mb.component_id IN (
    SELECT parent_component_id FROM component_tree
    UNION
    SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039'
)
AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01');
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_components AS (
    -- Direct model -> component edges
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Assembly component -> sub-component edges, joining to models that use the assembly
    SELECT 
        mc.model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN model_components mc ON c.parent_code = mc.component_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'component'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_code) AS model_count
FROM model_components
WHERE component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: find all company models that directly contain TAB-548-GRY-00039
    SELECT 
        c.model_id,
        c.model_code,
        comp.component_code AS child_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN company_model c ON uc.parent_code = c.model_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'model'
    JOIN component comp ON uc.child_code = comp.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE comp.component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow through sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.model_id,
        be.model_code,
        uc.child_code,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = be.child_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'
    JOIN component comp ON uc.child_code = comp.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = false
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

-- Also need to handle the case where TAB-548-GRY-00039 is inside an assembly that is inside a model
model_to_assembly AS (
    -- Find assemblies that contain TAB-548-GRY-00039 (directly or nested)
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS assembly_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN component comp ON uc.child_code = comp.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE comp.component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039'
      AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS assembly_code,
        mta.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_to_assembly mta
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.child_code = mta.assembly_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    JOIN component comp ON uc.parent_code = comp.component_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

-- Find models that contain those assemblies
models_with_assembly AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.model_id,
        c.model_code
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN company_model c ON uc.parent_code = c.model_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'model'
    JOIN model_to_assembly mta ON uc.child_code = mta.assembly_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)

-- Count distinct models
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) AS model_count
FROM (
    SELECT model_id FROM bom_explosion
    UNION
    SELECT model_id FROM models_with_assembly
) all_models
```

```sql
-- Resolve bundle BDL-DE-0236 to its item SKUs
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku b ON b.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE b.sku_code = 'BDL-DE-0236'
),
-- Map item SKUs to company models
item_models AS (
    SELECT sm.model_id, sm.qty AS sku_model_qty, bi.bundle_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),
-- Expand model BOM recursively to leaf parts
model_expansion AS (
    -- Base: model -> component edges (current)
    SELECT im.model_id,
           mb.component_id,
           CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) * im.sku_model_qty * im.bundle_qty AS total_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = im.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive: assembly -> child components (current)
    SELECT me.model_id,
           cb.child_component_id,
           me.total_qty * cb.qty
    FROM model_expansion me
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = me.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = me.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(me.total_qty), 0) AS units
FROM model_expansion me
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = me.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'MOT-763-WAL-01458'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the part component
part AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'LEG-407-OAK-00192'
),
-- Recursively expand component BOM from each model's direct components

    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION
    -- Expand assemblies
    SELECT mc.model_id, cb.child_component_id
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mc.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = mc.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
),
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Order lines for Walmart-US-10 in 2025, completed
lines AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.line_no, ol.qty, o.order_date, l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id

    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.store_name = 'Walmart-US-10'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- 2. Expand bundles into item SKUs (recursive, bundles can nest)
sku_expand AS (
    -- non-bundle lines: base
    SELECT l.order_id, l.line_no, l.order_date, l.sku_id AS sku_id, CAST(l.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = FALSE
    UNION ALL
    -- bundle lines: expand into items
    SELECT se.order_id, se.line_no, se.order_date, bi.item_sku_id, se.qty * bi.qty
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Find the target part
target AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'BRA-310-WHT-02971'
),

-- 2. Completed order lines for store Amazon-JP-18 in 2024
lines AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.line_no, ol.listing_id, ol.qty, o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = l.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-JP-18'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),

-- 3. Resolve each line to SKU
line_sku AS (
    SELECT ln.order_id, ln.line_no, ln.qty, ln.order_date, l.sku_id
    FROM lines ln
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ln.listing_id
),

-- 4. Expand bundles into item SKUs (recursive, bundles can nest)
sku_expand AS (
    -- non-bundle SKUs: base case
    SELECT ls.order_id, ls.line_no, ls.order_date, ls.sku_id AS sku_id, ls.qty AS qty
    FROM line_sku ls
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = ls.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    -- bundle SKUs: expand into items
    SELECT se.order_id, se.line_no, se.order_date, bi.item_sku_id, se.qty * bi.qty
    FROM sku_expand se
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = se.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = se.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = TRUE
),

-- 5. Map SKUs to models
sku_model_expand AS (
    SELECT se.order_id, se.line_no, se.order_date, sm.model_id, se.qty * sm.qty AS qty
    FROM sku_expand se
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = se.sku_id
),

-- 6. Explode model BOM recursively, respecting validity on order date
model_bom_expand AS (
    -- base: model -> component
    SELECT sme.order_id, sme.line_no, sme.order_date,
           mb.component_id, sme.qty * mb.qty AS qty
    FROM sku_model_expand sme
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sme.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sme.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sme.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- recursive: assembly component -> child component
    SELECT mbe.order_id, mbe.line_no, mbe.order_date,
           cb.child_component_id, mbe.qty * cb.qty
    FROM model_bom_expand mbe
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mbe.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = mbe.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= mbe.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mbe.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mbe.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM model_bom_expand mbe
JOIN target t ON t.component_id = mbe.component_id;
```

```sql
sku_model AS (
    -- Direct: non-bundle SKU -> model

    FROM u_composition uc
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- SKUs that map to the target model directly (non-bundle SKU -> model)
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT child_code AS sku_code
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND child_kind = 'model'
      AND child_code = 'ER1-160OAK94-0191'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Bundles containing those SKUs (bundle -> item SKU)
bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT parent_code AS sku_code
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND child_kind = 'sku'
      AND child_code IN (SELECT sku_code FROM direct_skus)
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- All SKUs whose units count toward the model
all_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_code FROM direct_skus
    UNION
    SELECT sku_code FROM bundle_skus
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty), 0) AS units_sold
FROM order_line ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND s.sku_code IN (SELECT sku_code FROM all_skus);
```

```sql
    -- direct model mapping
    SELECT c.parent_code AS sku_code, c.qty AS qty
```

```sql
        child_component_id,

    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

)
```

```sql
        mb.component_id,
```
```sql
        mb.qty
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
```

```sql
    SELECT m.model_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the component_id for the target model's root component
model_root AS (
    SELECT c.component_id
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'CO8-120WHT43-0043'
    AND mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all parts from the root component
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: start with the root component itself
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty
    FROM component c
    JOIN model_root mr ON c.component_id = mr.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: join with component BOM to get children
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        ep.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ep.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE ep.is_assembly = true
    AND cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
-- Sum up costs for all parts (non-assembly components)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_qty * unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM exploded_parts
WHERE is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the model_id for ER2-120GRY40-0525
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id 
    FROM company_model 
    WHERE model_code = 'ER2-120GRY40-0525'
),
-- Current date for BOM validity
current_date_val AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS d
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all components from the model BOM
-- Starting with model BOM components
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    CROSS JOIN current_date_val cv
    WHERE mb.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
      AND mb.valid_from <= cv.d 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR cv.d <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursively explode assembly components
exploded AS (
    -- Base: components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        mc.component_id,
        mc.total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode child components of assemblies

        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        e.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty

      AND cb.valid_from <= cv.d

)
```

```sql
target_store AS (
    SELECT store_id 
    FROM store 
    WHERE store_name = 'Shopify-JP-03'
),

-- Get all completed orders from target store in 2025
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKU info
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id
),

-- For bundle SKUs, explode to item SKUs
exploded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map directly to their models
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id as original_sku_id,
        ol.sku_id as resolved_sku_id,
        ol.line_qty as sku_qty,  -- qty of this SKU in the order line
        1 as bundle_multiplier   -- not in a bundle, so multiplier is 1
    FROM order_lines ol
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: explode to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id as original_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id as resolved_sku_id,
        bi.qty as sku_qty,  -- qty of item SKU within the bundle
        ol.line_qty as bundle_multiplier  -- how many bundles ordered
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map SKUs to models with quantities
sku_to_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_qty,
        es.original_sku_id,
        es.resolved_sku_id,
        es.sku_qty,
        es.bundle_multiplier,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty as model_per_sku_qty
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.resolved_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total model units needed per order line
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        model_id,
        SUM(line_qty * bundle_multiplier * sku_qty * model_per_sku_qty) as total_model_qty
    FROM sku_to_models
    GROUP BY order_id, model_id
),

-- Get order dates for BOM validity
order_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, order_date
    FROM store_orders
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode model BOM to components
-- Start with model_bom
model_bom_exploded AS (
    SELECT 
        mu.order_id,
        mu.model_id as root_model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mu.total_model_qty * mb.qty as total_qty,
        od.order_date
    FROM model_units mu
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mu.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN order_dates od ON mu.order_id = od.order_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= od.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR od.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        mbe.order_id,
        mbe.root_model_id,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        mbe.total_qty * cb.qty as total_qty,
        mbe.order_date
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN order_dates od ON mbe.order_id = od.order_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= mbe.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mbe.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up all quantities for the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) as total_consumed
FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
JOIN target_part tp ON mbe.component_id = tp.component_id;
```

```sql
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.line_qty,
        es.order_date,
        es.final_sku_id,
        es.sku_multiplier,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.final_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total model quantity per order line: line_qty * sku_multiplier * model_qty_per_sku
model_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        line_no,
        order_date,
        model_id,
        line_qty * sku_multiplier * model_qty_per_sku AS total_model_qty
    FROM sku_models
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode model BOM to components, then component BOMs recursively
-- Start with model BOM
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base: model BOM edges
    SELECT 
        mc.order_id,
        mc.line_no,
        mc.order_date,
        mc.total_model_qty,
        mb.component_id AS current_component_id,
        mb.qty AS bom_qty,
        mc.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_consumption mc
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mc.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= mc.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mc.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: component BOM edges for assembly components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_date,
        be.total_model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS current_component_id,
        cb.qty AS bom_qty,
        be.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN component c ON be.current_component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= be.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
),

part_consumption AS (

        be.line_no,
        be.order_date,
        be.total_qty,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN component c ON be.current_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
)

-- Sum total consumption of the specific part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_units_consumed
FROM part_consumption
WHERE component_code = 'BRA-854-OAK-01427';
```

```sql
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2024-12-31'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-01-01')
      AND pt.depth < 50

    UNION
    SELECT child_component_id FROM part_tree

        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS model_qty,

        mb.valid_to
    FROM model_bom mb

      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-01-01')
),

    FROM sku_model sm
    WHERE sm.model_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT model_id FROM model_part_usage)
),

sku_part_usage AS (
    SELECT sku_id, model_id, sku_model_qty FROM sku_model_usage
    UNION ALL
    SELECT

    FROM bundle_item bi

    SELECT 
```
```sql
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.order_date,
        es.sku_qty,
```

```sql
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty AS model_qty  -- total quantity of this model needed
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id

        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.model_qty AS parent_qty,
        mb.component_id AS child_component_id,

        sm.model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM sku_models sm

    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= be.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (

    FROM component

      AND is_assembly = false
),
bom_edges AS (
    SELECT 
        c.parent_component_id,
        c.child_component_id,
        c.qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM component_bom c
),
model_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty,
        mb.valid_from,
        mb.valid_to
    FROM model_bom mb
),
-- Recursively expand component BOM to find all paths from any component down to the target part
component_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: the target part itself (qty 1 per unit of itself)
    SELECT 
        pt.component_id AS root_component_id,
        pt.component_id AS current_component_id,
        1.0 AS qty_multiplier,
        0 AS depth
    FROM part_tree pt
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: go up the BOM (parent uses child)
    SELECT 
        cp.root_component_id,
        be.parent_component_id,
        cp.qty_multiplier * be.qty,
        cp.depth + 1
    FROM component_paths cp
    JOIN bom_edges be ON be.child_component_id = cp.current_component_id
    WHERE cp.depth < 50
),
-- For each root component, sum the total qty of the target part per unit of that root component
component_to_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        root_component_id,
        SUM(qty_multiplier) AS part_qty_per_unit
    FROM component_paths
    GROUP BY root_component_id
),
-- Expand model BOM to components, then map to part qty
model_to_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        SUM(mb.qty * COALESCE(cpq.part_qty_per_unit, 0)) AS part_qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom mb
    LEFT JOIN component_to_part_qty cpq ON cpq.root_component_id = mb.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY mb.model_id
),
-- SKU to model mapping (non-bundle)
sku_to_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        SUM(sm.qty * mpq.part_qty_per_model) AS part_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN model_to_part_qty mpq ON mpq.model_id = sm.model_id
    GROUP BY sm.sku_id
),

bundle_expanded AS (
    -- Anchor: all SKUs (both bundle and non-bundle)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        1.0 AS qty_multiplier,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM sales_sku s
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundle contains item SKUs
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        be.root_sku_id,
        be.qty_multiplier * bi.qty,
        si.is_bundle
    FROM bundle_expanded be
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = be.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku si ON si.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id

root_sku_to_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        be.root_sku_id,
        SUM(be.qty_multiplier * COALESCE(spq.part_qty_per_sku, 0)) AS part_qty_per_root_sku
    FROM bundle_expanded be
    LEFT JOIN sku_to_part_qty spq ON spq.sku_id = be.sku_id
    GROUP BY be.root_sku_id
```

```sql
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false

    UNION ALL
    SELECT order_id, line_qty, order_date, sku_id, bundle_item_qty FROM non_bundle

    FROM all_skus a
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders for Walmart-CA-04 in 2024
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Walmart-CA-04'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_lines_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id
),

-- Expand bundles to get the underlying item SKUs with their quantities
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly map to models
    SELECT 
        ols.order_id,
        ols.line_no,
        ols.line_qty,
        ols.order_date,
        ols.sku_id as original_sku_id,
        ols.sku_code as original_sku_code,
        ols.sku_id as item_sku_id,
        ols.line_qty as sku_qty  -- qty of the SKU in the order
    FROM order_lines_sku ols
    WHERE ols.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ols.order_id,
        ols.line_no,
        ols.line_qty,
        ols.order_date,
        ols.sku_id as original_sku_id,
        ols.sku_code as original_sku_code,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        ols.line_qty * bi.qty as sku_qty  -- bundle qty * item qty within bundle
    FROM order_lines_sku ols
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ols.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ols.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map SKUs to models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.sku_qty,
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS current_code,
        c.child_kind AS current_kind,
        c.qty AS path_qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'

      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: traverse down through all composition types
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS current_code,
        c.child_kind AS current_kind,
        bp.path_qty * c.qty AS path_qty,
        bp.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON c.parent_kind = bp.current_kind 
        AND c.parent_code = bp.current_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')

                          WHERE comp.component_code = bp.current_code

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all model -> component edges (direct or through sub-assemblies)
-- Starting from models, follow composition down to components
model_to_component AS (
    -- Direct model -> component edges
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Model -> assembly component -> ... -> component
    -- We need to traverse through assembly components
    SELECT 
        mtc.model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        mtc.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_to_component mtc
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = mtc.component_code
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = mtc.component_code
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = true
      AND c.parent_kind = 'component'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- Also need to handle SKU -> model -> component paths
-- Get SKU -> model mappings
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- For bundle SKUs, get item SKUs
bundle_to_item AS (
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        c.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        c.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- All paths from any SKU to models (direct or through bundles)
all_sku_models AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly to models
    SELECT sku_code, model_code, qty FROM sku_to_model
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs to item SKUs to models
    SELECT 
        b.bundle_sku_code AS sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        b.qty * sm.qty AS qty
    FROM bundle_to_item b
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON sm.sku_code = b.item_sku_code
),

-- Now get all models that contain the target component
models_with_component AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT model_code
    FROM model_to_component
    WHERE component_code = 'BRA-537-BLK-00145'
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_code) AS model_count
FROM models_with_component;
```

```sql
    -- Direct SKU to model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        m.model_id,

        AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        b.sku_code,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        bundle_edge.qty * item_edge.qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition bundle_edge 
        ON bundle_edge.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND bundle_edge.parent_code = b.sku_code

        AND bundle_edge.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
```

```sql
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
```
```sql
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
```
```sql
),

    -- Base case: direct components from models
    SELECT 
        mc.model_code,

        mc.comp_qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL

      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bundle_to_sku AS (
    -- Direct bundle SKU -> item SKU edges
    SELECT 
        parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        child_code AS item_sku_code,
        qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND child_kind = 'sku'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),
sku_to_model AS (
    -- SKU -> model edges
    SELECT 
        parent_code AS sku_code,
        child_code AS model_code,
        qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND child_kind = 'model'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),
bundles_with_model AS (
    -- Bundle SKUs that contain the target model through their item SKUs
    SELECT DISTINCT
        b.bundle_sku_code
    FROM bundle_to_sku b
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON b.item_sku_code = sm.sku_code
    WHERE sm.model_code = 'ER1-120WHT29-0417'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bundle_sku_code) FROM bundles_with_model;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all SKUs and their model mappings (direct or through bundles)
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT 
        b.sku_code,
        c2.child_code AS model_code,
        c1.qty * c2.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition c1 ON c1.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c1.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND c1.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_code = c1.child_code AND item.is_bundle = false
    JOIN u_composition c2 ON c2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c2.parent_code = item.sku_code
        AND c2.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),
-- Get all order lines with their SKU and model info in 2025
order_lines_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
        AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)
-- Calculate total units of model ER1-160OAK94-0191 sold
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * stm.model_qty), 0) AS total_units_sold
FROM order_lines_2025 ol
JOIN sku_to_model stm ON stm.sku_code = ol.sku_code
WHERE stm.model_code = 'ER1-160OAK94-0191';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs (direct or inside bundles) that map to model ER9-160BLK90-0090
-- Need to handle: direct SKU->model edges and bundle SKU->item SKU->model paths

-- Get all valid SKU-to-model compositions as of 2026-10-01 (current, but we need to find which SKUs map to the model)
-- Actually we need the composition structure to find SKUs that contain this model

-- Step 1: Find all leaf paths from SKUs to the target model
-- We need to expand bundle SKUs down to their item SKUs, then item SKUs to models

-- First, get all SKU-level composition edges (these are always valid)
sku_edges AS (
    SELECT parent_code as sku_code, child_code as child_sku_code, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND child_kind = 'sku'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),

-- SKU to model edges
sku_model_edges AS (
    SELECT parent_code as sku_code, child_code as model_code, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND child_kind = 'model'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),

-- Recursive: find all SKUs that ultimately contain a given model (directly or through bundles)
-- Start from SKUs that map directly to the target model
model_to_skus AS (
    -- Direct mapping
    SELECT sku_code, model_code, qty as model_qty, 1 as depth
    FROM sku_model_edges
    WHERE model_code = 'ER9-160BLK90-0090'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundles that contain SKUs that map to the model
    SELECT e.sku_code, m.model_code, e.qty * m.model_qty as model_qty, m.depth + 1
    FROM sku_edges e
    JOIN model_to_skus m ON e.child_sku_code = m.sku_code
    WHERE m.depth < 10  -- prevent infinite loops
),

-- Get the total model quantity per SKU (sum over all paths)
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT sku_code, SUM(model_qty) as total_model_qty
    FROM model_to_skus
    GROUP BY sku_code
),

-- Get all listings for these SKUs
relevant_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, l.sku_id, s.sku_code, smq.total_model_qty
    FROM listing l
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model_qty smq ON s.sku_code = smq.sku_code
),

-- Get completed orders in 2023
completed_2023_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Calculate total units sold
sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty * rl.total_model_qty as model_units_sold
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN relevant_listings rl ON ol.listing_id = rl.listing_id
    JOIN completed_2023_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(model_units_sold), 0)::BIGINT as total_units_sold
FROM sales
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, find all SKUs (direct and inside bundles) that map to model NO8-140GRY89-0768
-- We need to trace: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model, and non-bundle SKU -> model

-- Step 1: Find direct SKU-to-model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
direct_sku_model AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        c.qty as sku_to_model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model' AND c.child_code = 'NO8-140GRY89-0768'
        AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
),

-- Step 2: Find bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs which map to the target model
-- Need to trace through bundle -> item SKU -> model
bundle_items AS (
    -- All bundle -> item SKU edges
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id as bundle_sku_id,
        b.sku_code as bundle_sku_code,
        c.child_code as item_sku_code,
        c.qty as bundle_to_item_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),

-- Step 3: Item SKUs that map to target model
item_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.bundle_sku_code,
        bi.item_sku_code,
        bi.bundle_to_item_qty,
        c2.qty as item_to_model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN u_composition c2 ON c2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c2.parent_code = bi.item_sku_code
        AND c2.child_kind = 'model' AND c2.child_code = 'NO8-140GRY89-0768'
        AND c2.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c2.valid_to IS NULL OR c2.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- Step 4: All SKUs that ultimately map to the target model with their multiplier
all_mapping_skus AS (
    -- Direct mappings: sku_id, multiplier = sku_to_model_qty
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_to_model_qty as multiplier
    FROM direct_sku_model
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle mappings: bundle_sku_id, multiplier = bundle_to_item_qty * item_to_model_qty
    SELECT 
        bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
        bundle_to_item_qty * item_to_model_qty as multiplier
    FROM item_to_model
),

-- Step 5: Get all completed orders in 2023 with their line quantities
order_lines_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' 
        AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- Step 6: Join order lines to listings to SKUs, then apply multipliers
sku_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ams.sku_id,
        ams.multiplier,
        ol.line_qty
    FROM order_lines_2023 ol
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN all_mapping_skus ams ON ams.sku_id = l.sku_id
)

-- Final: sum up all units of the model sold
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(multiplier * line_qty), 0) as total_units_sold
FROM sku_sales
```

```sql
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)

    SELECT 
        bu.start_kind,
        bu.start_code,
        c.parent_kind,
        c.parent_code,
        bu.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        bu.level + 1
    FROM bom_upward bu
    JOIN u_composition c ON 
        c.child_kind = bu.parent_kind
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all SKUs and their direct or indirect model mappings with quantities
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct SKU -> model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty,
        1 AS path_multiplier  -- direct path, no bundle expansion needed
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
                        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model (recursive through bundle contents)
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        b.sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        c.qty * sm.model_qty AS model_qty,
        c.qty AS path_multiplier
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = b.sku_code
                        AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON sm.sku_code = c.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get all order lines with their SKU and model info, expanded for bundle contents
order_model_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        sm.model_code,
        sm.model_qty,
        -- Total model units = order line qty * SKU-to-model qty
        ol.qty * sm.model_qty AS total_model_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
    LEFT JOIN sku_to_model sm ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
)

SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(oml.total_model_units), 0) AS units_sold
FROM order_model_lines oml
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oml.order_id

  AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
  AND oml.model_code = 'AL4-120BLK95-0386';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, find all SKUs (direct or in bundles) that map to model VI4-180WAL93-0675
-- We need to explode bundle SKUs to their item SKUs, then find which item SKUs map to the target model

-- Step 1: Get all SKU-to-model edges (direct or via bundle explosion)
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct: non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code AS original_sku,
        s.sku_code AS resolved_sku,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model (need to explode bundles)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code AS original_sku,
        c2.child_code AS resolved_sku,
        c3.child_code AS model_code,
        c2.qty * c3.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c2 ON c2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c2.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c2.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND c2.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31' AND (c2.valid_to IS NULL OR c2.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
    JOIN u_composition c3 ON c3.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c3.parent_code = c2.child_code
        AND c3.child_kind = 'model'
        AND c3.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31' AND (c3.valid_to IS NULL OR c3.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true
),

-- Step 2: Calculate total model units sold per original SKU
model_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.original_sku,
        sm.model_code,
        SUM(ol.qty * sm.model_qty) AS total_model_units
    FROM sku_to_model sm
    JOIN listing l ON l.sku_id = (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = sm.original_sku)
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
        AND o.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
        AND sm.model_code = 'VI4-180WAL93-0675'
    GROUP BY sm.original_sku, sm.model_code
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_model_units), 0) AS units_sold
FROM model_sales
```

```sql
-- First, find all SKUs and their quantities that map to model AL2-160OAK53-0538 (directly or through bundles)
-- We need to trace: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model, or non-bundle SKU -> model

-- Step 1: Find all direct SKU -> model mappings for our target model
direct_sku_model AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        1 AS model_qty_per_sku  -- qty from u_composition for sku->model
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.child_code = 'AL2-160OAK53-0538'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Step 2: Find bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs which map to our target model
-- Need to recursively explode bundles
bundle_explosion AS (
    -- Base: direct bundle -> item SKU edges
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id AS bundle_sku_id,
        b.sku_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        b.is_bundle,
        s2.sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        s2.sku_code AS item_sku_code,
        s2.is_bundle AS item_is_bundle,
        uc.qty AS qty_in_bundle
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku s2 ON s2.sku_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested bundles
    SELECT 
        be.bundle_sku_id,
        be.bundle_sku_code,
        be.is_bundle,
        s2.sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        s2.sku_code AS item_sku_code,
        s2.is_bundle AS item_is_bundle,
        be.qty_in_bundle * uc.qty AS qty_in_bundle
    FROM bundle_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = be.item_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku s2 ON s2.sku_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE be.item_is_bundle = true
),

-- Step 3: Find all item SKUs (from bundles) that map to our target model
bundle_item_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        be.bundle_sku_id,
        be.bundle_sku_code,
        be.item_sku_id,
        be.item_sku_code,
        be.qty_in_bundle * uc.qty AS total_model_qty_per_bundle
    FROM bundle_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = be.item_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.child_code = 'AL2-160OAK53-0538'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE be.item_is_bundle = false  -- item SKU must not be a bundle itself
),

-- Step 4: Combine all SKUs that map to our target model with their model quantities
all_mapping_skus AS (
    -- Direct non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        model_qty_per_sku AS model_qty_per_sku_unit
    FROM direct_sku_model
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs (they map through their contents)
    SELECT 
        bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        bundle_sku_code AS sku_code,
        total_model_qty_per_bundle AS model_qty_per_sku_unit
    FROM bundle_item_to_model
),

-- Step 5: Get all order lines in 2025 for these SKUs, with completed orders
order_lines_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty,
        l.sku_id,
        ams.model_qty_per_sku_unit

    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id

    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
        AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty * model_qty_per_sku_unit), 0)::BIGINT AS total_units_sold
FROM order_lines_2025
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs that map to model SW3-120WAL60-0060, either directly or through bundles
model_to_sku_paths AS (
    -- Direct SKU -> model edges (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code as sku_code,
        s.sku_id as sku_id,
        c.qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN sales_sku s ON c.child_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model' 
      AND c.parent_code = 'SW3-120WAL60-0060'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model paths
    -- Start from item SKUs that map to the model, then find bundles containing them
    SELECT 
        b.sku_code as sku_code,
        b.sku_id as sku_id,
        c_bundle.qty * c_model.qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition c_model
    JOIN sales_sku item_sku ON c_model.child_kind = 'sku' AND c_model.parent_code = item_sku.sku_code
    JOIN u_composition c_bundle ON c_bundle.child_kind = 'sku' AND c_bundle.parent_code = item_sku.sku_code
    JOIN sales_sku b ON c_bundle.parent_kind = 'sku' AND b.sku_code = c_bundle.parent_code AND b.is_bundle = true
    WHERE c_model.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c_model.parent_code = 'SW3-120WAL60-0060'
      AND c_model.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (c_model.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c_model.valid_to)
      AND c_bundle.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c_bundle.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c_bundle.valid_to)
),

-- Get all valid listings for these SKUs
sku_listings AS (
    SELECT 
        l.listing_id,
        p.sku_code,
        p.model_qty_per_sku
    FROM model_to_sku_paths p
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs (both direct and inside bundles) that map to model ER6-140OAK37-0231
-- We need to trace: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model, and also direct: SKU -> model

-- Step 1: Find all SKU-to-model edges (direct or through bundles)
-- Direct edges: sku -> model
-- Bundle edges: bundle_sku -> item_sku, then item_sku -> model

-- Get all valid SKU-level composition edges (these are always valid)
sku_edges AS (
    SELECT parent_code as parent_sku, child_code as child_sku, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND child_kind = 'sku'
      AND valid_from = '1900-01-01' AND valid_to IS NULL
),

-- Get all valid SKU-to-model edges (direct)
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT parent_code as sku_code, child_code as model_code, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND child_kind = 'model'
      AND valid_from = '1900-01-01' AND valid_to IS NULL
),

-- Recursive: find all SKUs that eventually map to our target model
-- This includes direct mappings and bundle items that map to the model
model_skus AS (
    -- Direct mappings
    SELECT sku_code, qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_to_model
    WHERE model_code = 'ER6-140OAK37-0231'
    
    UNION
    
    -- Bundle items that map to the model
    SELECT e.parent_sku as sku_code, e.qty * sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_edges e
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON e.child_sku = sm.sku_code
    WHERE sm.model_code = 'ER6-140OAK37-0231'
),

-- Get all orders in 2024 with completed status
completed_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'completed'
      AND order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines for these orders with SKU info
order_lines_with_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN completed_orders_2024 co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
)

-- Calculate total units of the model sold
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(ol.line_qty * ms.model_qty), 0) as total_model_units_sold
FROM order_lines_with_sku ol
JOIN model_skus ms ON ol.sku_code = ms.sku_code
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all completed orders for Amazon-JP-13 in 2024 with their order lines
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
      AND o.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-JP-13')
),

-- Recursive explosion of BOM: start from SKU and traverse down to components
-- We need to handle: SKU -> model -> component -> sub-component, and bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model -> ...
bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start from order lines with SKUs
    -- For non-bundle SKUs, we go to models. For bundle SKUs, we go to item SKUs.
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS parent_code,
        ol.sku_code AS child_code,
        'sku' AS child_kind,
        ol.line_qty AS total_qty,
        0 AS depth
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: traverse composition edges
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.line_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_sku_code,
        be.child_code AS parent_code,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.child_kind,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        be.depth + 1
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = be.child_kind 
       AND uc.parent_code = be.child_code
       AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date 
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE be.depth < 20  -- safety limit
),

-- Get all leaf-level components (parts, not assemblies)
leaf_components AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.line_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_sku_code,
        be.child_code AS component_code,
        be.total_qty AS consumed_qty
    FROM bom_exploded be
    JOIN component c 
        ON c.component_code = be.child_code 
       AND c.is_assembly = false
    -- Only include rows where child is a component (leaf in our tree)
    WHERE be.child_kind = 'component'
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(lc.consumed_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM leaf_components lc
WHERE lc.component_code = 'FOO-735-BLK-02225'
```

```sql
        sk.is_bundle,
        so.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing li ON ol.listing_id = li.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON li.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode compositions
-- We track: parent kind, parent code, the root sku_code, quantity multiplier, and date
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start from order lines (SKUs)
    SELECT 
        'sku' AS parent_kind,
        ol.sku_code AS parent_code,
        ol.sku_code AS root_sku,
        ol.line_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_code AS child_code,
        'sku' AS child_kind,
        1 AS child_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand compositions
    SELECT 
        c.parent_kind,
        c.parent_code,
        e.root_sku,
        e.qty_multiplier * c.qty AS qty_multiplier,
        e.order_date,
        c.child_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON e.child_kind = c.parent_kind 
       AND e.child_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= e.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= c.valid_to)
),

-- Get all paths that reach components
component_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        root_sku,
        qty_multiplier,
        order_date,
        child_code AS component_code,
        child_qty
    FROM exploded
    WHERE child_kind = 'component'
),

-- For assembly components, we need to continue exploding until we reach parts
-- But we already do this in the recursive CTE above since components can be parents too
-- Let's get the final leaf components (parts, i.e., non-assembly)
-- Actually, we need to check if the component is an assembly and continue if so
-- The recursive CTE already handles this. We just need to filter to parts at the end.

-- Get all component occurrences with their total multiplied quantities
all_components AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.root_sku,
        cp.order_date,
        cp.component_code,
        cp.qty_multiplier * cp.child_qty AS total_qty
    FROM component_paths cp
),

-- Find which components are assemblies that were further expanded
assembly_expansions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT parent_code AS assembly_code
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'component'
),

-- Final parts: components that either are not assemblies or weren't expanded further
-- Actually, we need to get the leaf nodes - components that are parts (is_assembly = false)
-- The recursive CTE gives us all nodes; we want the ones where no further expansion exists

-- Let's identify leaf component nodes: those that either are parts or have no valid children on that date
leaf_components AS (
    SELECT 
        ac.root_sku,
        ac.order_date,
        ac.component_code,
        ac.total_qty
    FROM all_components ac
    JOIN component comp ON ac.component_code = comp.component_code
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION
    
    -- Also include assembly components that couldn't be expanded (no valid children)
    SELECT 
        ac.root_sku,
        ac.order_date,
        ac.component_code,
        ac.total_qty
    FROM all_components ac
    JOIN component comp ON ac.component_code = comp.component_code
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = true
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM u_composition c
          WHERE c.parent_kind = 'component'
            AND c.parent_code = ac.component_code
            AND c.valid_from <= ac.order_date
            AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR ac.order_date <= c.valid_to)
      )
),

-- Sum up total consumption of BRA-310-WHT-02971
total_consumption AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_units
    FROM leaf_components
    WHERE component_code = 'BRA-310-WHT-02971'
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders in UK in 2025
uk_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'UK'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines with their quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.listing_id, ol.qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN uk_orders uo ON ol.order_id = uo.order_id
),

-- Get SKU quantities sold (accounting for bundle expansion)
-- Step 1: Get SKU-level sales with quantities
sku_sales AS (
    SELECT l.sku_id, SUM(ol.qty) as total_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    GROUP BY l.sku_id
),

-- Recursive expansion of compositions
-- We need to expand: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model, or non-bundle SKU -> model
-- Start from SKUs and expand down to models
expanded AS (
    -- Base case: direct SKU to model or SKU to SKU (bundle items)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.total_qty as base_qty,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty as edge_qty,
        s.total_qty * uc.qty as accumulated_qty
    FROM sku_sales s
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON s.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = sk.sku_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: continue expanding
    SELECT 
        e.sku_id,
        e.base_qty,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty as edge_qty,
        e.accumulated_qty * uc.qty as accumulated_qty
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = e.child_kind 
        AND uc.parent_code = e.child_code
    WHERE e.child_kind IN ('sku', 'model')  -- can expand from SKU or model
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Get model quantities (when child_kind = 'model', we need to go one more step to component? No, we want models)
-- Actually we want models, so we need to capture when we reach 'model'
model_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        e.sku_id,
        e.base_qty,
        e.child_code as model_code,
        e.accumulated_qty as model_qty
    FROM expanded e
    WHERE e.child_kind = 'model'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also handle non-bundle SKUs that map directly to models (already in expanded, but let's be explicit)
    -- Actually the base case handles this. But we also need SKUs that don't go through bundles
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.total_qty as base_qty,
        uc.child_code as model_code,
        s.total_qty * uc.qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_sales s
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON s.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = sk.sku_code
    WHERE uc.child_kind = 'model'
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM expanded e2 
          WHERE e2.sku_id = s.sku_id AND e2.child_kind = 'model'
      )
),

-- Aggregate model quantities
model_totals AS (
    SELECT model_code, SUM(model_qty) as total_units
    FROM model_quantities
    GROUP BY model_code
)

SELECT model_code
FROM model_totals
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,

        sk.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode compositions
-- We track: the original order line, current item, its kind, code, and cumulative quantity
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start from order lines with SKUs
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.line_no,
        osl.line_qty,
        'sku' AS item_kind,
        osl.sku_code AS item_code,
        osl.line_qty AS cum_qty,
        osl.order_id || '-' || osl.line_no || '-sku-' || osl.sku_code AS path
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand current item using valid composition edges
    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.line_no,
        e.line_qty,
        uc.child_kind AS item_kind,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        e.cum_qty * uc.qty AS cum_qty,
        e.path || '->' || uc.child_kind || '-' || uc.child_code AS path
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN order_sku_lines osl ON e.order_id = osl.order_id AND e.line_no = osl.line_no
    JOIN u_composition uc ON 
        uc.parent_kind = e.item_kind 
        AND uc.parent_code = e.item_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= osl.order_date
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR osl.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

        e.order_id,
        e.line_no,
        e.line_qty,
        e.item_kind,
        e.item_code,
        e.cum_qty,
        e.path
    FROM exploded e
    WHERE e.item_kind = 'component'
),

-- Find which component paths are terminal (no further expansion possible)
terminal_components AS (
    SELECT 
        acp.order_id,
        acp.line_no,
        acp.item_code,
        acp.cum_qty
    FROM all_component_paths acp
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM u_composition uc
        JOIN order_sku_lines osl ON acp.order_id = osl.order_id AND acp.line_no = osl.line_no
        WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'component'
          AND uc.parent_code = acp.item_code
          AND uc.valid_from <= osl.order_date
          AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR osl.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    )
)

-- Sum up consumption of the specific part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tc.cum_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM terminal_components tc
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_path AS (
    -- Base case: start from the company model TE8-180WAL45-0142
    -- Find direct component children of the model
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        uc.qty as path_qty,
        1 as level
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN component c ON uc.child_code = c.component_code
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND uc.parent_code = 'TE8-180WAL45-0142'
      AND uc.child_kind = 'component'

    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        bp.path_qty * uc.qty as path_qty,
        bp.level + 1 as level
    FROM bom_path bp
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = bp.component_code
    JOIN component c ON uc.child_code = c.component_code
    WHERE bp.is_assembly = true
      AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'

      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2024-02-26'
```

```sql
-- First, get the model_id for the target model
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id, model_code
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'SW2-120GRY39-0330'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: start from model, go through components and assemblies
-- We need to follow: model -> component (via u_composition where parent_kind='model')
-- Then component -> component for assemblies
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the model
    SELECT 
        m.model_id,
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        uc.qty as qty_per_parent,
        uc.qty as total_qty,
        1 as level
    FROM target_model m
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'model' AND uc.parent_code = m.model_code
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2024-03-17' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2024-03-17')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: assemblies -> their children
    SELECT 
        be.model_id,
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        uc.qty as qty_per_parent,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty as total_qty,
        be.level + 1 as level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'component' AND uc.parent_code = be.component_code
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE be.is_assembly = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2024-03-17' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2024-03-17')
)

-- Sum up costs for all parts (non-assembly components)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_bom AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'SW9-140GRY22-0604'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode assemblies into their sub-components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        mb.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'component' 
                         AND c.parent_code = mb.component_code
                         AND c.child_kind = 'component'
                         AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-01-01'
                         AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-01-01')
    JOIN component parent_comp ON parent_comp.component_code = mb.component_code
    WHERE parent_comp.is_assembly = true
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(mb.total_qty * comp.unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM model_bom mb
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = mb.component_code
WHERE comp.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Shopify-JP-03')
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025
),
listing_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.order_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
),
-- For non-bundle SKUs, get the model mappings valid on order date
non_bundle_models AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.listing_id,
        ls.order_qty,
        ls.order_date,
        ls.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM listing_skus ls
    JOIN u_composition uc 
      ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
     AND uc.parent_code = ls.sku_code 
     AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
     AND uc.valid_from <= ls.order_date
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR ls.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE ls.is_bundle = false
),
-- For bundle SKUs, explode to item SKUs, then to models
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.listing_id,
        ls.order_qty,
        ls.order_date,
        ls.sku_code AS bundle_sku,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        uc.qty AS item_qty
    FROM listing_skus ls
    JOIN u_composition uc 
      ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
     AND uc.parent_code = ls.sku_code 
     AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
     AND uc.valid_from <= ls.order_date
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR ls.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE ls.is_bundle = true
),
bundle_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.listing_id,
        bi.order_qty,
        bi.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_code,
        bi.item_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN u_composition uc 
      ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
     AND uc.parent_code = bi.item_sku_code 
     AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
     AND uc.valid_from <= bi.order_date
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bi.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),
-- Combine all model-level requirements
all_models AS (
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        order_qty,
        order_date,
        model_code,
        model_qty
    FROM non_bundle_models
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        order_qty,
        order_date,
        model_code,
        item_qty * model_qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_models
),
-- Explode models to components using u_explosion for the specific part
part_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        am.listing_id,
        am.order_qty,
        am.order_date,
        am.model_code,
        am.model_qty,
        ue.qty AS part_qty_per_model
    FROM all_models am
    JOIN u_explosion ue 
      ON ue.root_kind = 'model' 
     AND ue.root_code = am.model_code 
     AND ue.item_kind = 'component' 
     AND ue.item_code = 'FAS-548-WAL-00203'
     AND ue.valid_from <= am.order_date
     AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR am.order_date <= ue.valid_to)
)
SELECT SUM(order_qty * model_qty * part_qty_per_model) AS total_units
FROM part_consumption;
```

```sql
WITH uk_completed_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'UK'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025
),
listing_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        l.listing_id,
        l.sku_id
    FROM listing l
),
sku_model_mapping AS (
    SELECT 
        sku.sku_id,
        sku.is_bundle,
        sku.sku_code
    FROM sales_sku sku
),
-- For non-bundle SKUs: direct model mapping
non_bundle_models AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.listing_id,
        sm.sku_id,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM listing_sku ls
    JOIN sku_model_mapping sm ON ls.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
       AND c.parent_code = sm.sku_code
       AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE sm.is_bundle = false
),
-- For bundle SKUs: get item SKUs, then their models
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.listing_id,
        sm.sku_id AS bundle_sku_id,
        c.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        c.qty AS item_qty_per_bundle
    FROM listing_sku ls
    JOIN sku_model_mapping sm ON ls.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON c.parent_kind = 'sku'
       AND c.parent_code = sm.sku_code
       AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE sm.is_bundle = true
),
bundle_item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.listing_id,
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_qty_per_bundle,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty_per_item_sku
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN u_composition c
        ON c.parent_kind = 'sku'
       AND c.parent_code = bi.item_sku_code
       AND c.child_kind = 'model'
),
-- Combine all listing -> model mappings with quantities
all_listing_models AS (
    SELECT listing_id, model_code, model_qty_per_sku AS qty_per_unit
    FROM non_bundle_models
    UNION ALL
    SELECT listing_id, model_code, item_qty_per_bundle * model_qty_per_item_sku AS qty_per_unit
    FROM bundle_item_models
),
-- Calculate total units per model
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        alm.model_code,
        SUM(uo.order_qty * alm.qty_per_unit) AS total_units
    FROM uk_completed_orders uo
    JOIN all_listing_models alm ON uo.listing_id = alm.listing_id
    GROUP BY alm.model_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Start with the model and its direct component children
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'NO4-160WHT62-0256'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        e.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind 
        AND c.parent_code = e.child_code
    WHERE e.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
      AND GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (CASE 
              WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
              WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
              ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END IS NULL 
           OR CASE 
              WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
              WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
              ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END >= DATE '2026-10-01')
```

```sql
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'component'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL

    FROM bom_explosion

    FROM all_component_links
    WHERE child_code = 'BRA-537-BLK-00145'
    
    UNION
    
    -- Also include if the component itself is the target
```

```sql
    -- Start from non-bundle SKUs that map to models
    SELECT 
        'sku' AS root_kind,
        s.sku_code AS root_code,

        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE AS qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false

      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

        be.root_kind,

            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
```
