        s.sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
    WHERE c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model (recursive through bundle contents)
    SELECT 
        b.sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        b.item_qty * sm.model_qty AS model_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            s.sku_code,
            c.child_code AS item_sku_code,
            c.qty AS item_qty
        FROM sales_sku s
        JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        WHERE c.child_kind = 'sku'
          AND s.is_bundle = true
          AND c.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
    ) b
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON sm.sku_code = b.item_sku_code

        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN store st ON l.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Amazon-JP-13'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),
-- For non-bundle SKUs, get model explosion; for bundles, get contained SKUs first
sku_to_models AS (
    -- Direct model mapping for non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = ol.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND ol.is_bundle = false
        AND ol.order_date >= uc.valid_from 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: explode to item SKUs, then those to models
    SELECT 
        ol.order_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_code,
        uc2.child_code AS model_code,
        uc1.qty * uc2.qty AS model_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN u_composition uc1 ON uc1.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc1.parent_code = ol.sku_code
        AND uc1.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND ol.is_bundle = true
        AND ol.order_date >= uc1.valid_from 
        AND (uc1.valid_to IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= uc1.valid_to)
    JOIN u_composition uc2 ON uc2.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc2.parent_code = uc1.child_code
        AND uc2.child_kind = 'model'
        AND ol.order_date >= uc2.valid_from
        AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= uc2.valid_to)
),
-- Now explode models to components using u_explosion
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.order_qty,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        sm.model_qty,
        ue.item_code AS component_code,
        ue.qty AS component_qty_per_model
    FROM sku_to_models sm
    JOIN u_explosion ue ON ue.root_kind = 'model'
        AND ue.root_code = sm.model_code
        AND ue.item_kind = 'component'
        AND sm.order_date >= ue.valid_from
        AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= ue.valid_to)
),
-- Filter to the specific part and calculate total consumption
part_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.order_qty * mc.model_qty * mc.component_qty_per_model AS total_part_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = mc.component_code
    WHERE mc.component_code = 'FOO-735-BLK-02225'
      AND c.is_assembly = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_part_qty), 0) AS total_units_consumed
FROM part_consumption

-- For bundle SKUs, use u_composition directly to get child SKUs
-- For non-bundle SKUs, use u_composition to get models

-- Step 1: For bundle SKUs, explode to child SKUs using u_composition where parent is sku
bundle_explosion AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        so.line_no,
        so.listing_id,
        so.order_line_qty,
        so.sku_id,
        so.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS child_sku_code,
        uc.qty AS composition_qty
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN u_composition uc ON so.sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= so.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR so.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE so.is_bundle = true
),

-- Step 2: Get all SKU-to-model mappings (for both direct non-bundle SKUs and exploded bundle children)
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly to models
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        so.line_no,
        so.listing_id,
        so.order_line_qty,
        so.sku_code,
        so.sku_code AS source_sku_code,
        1 AS sku_multiplier,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN u_composition uc ON so.sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= so.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR so.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE so.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle child SKUs to models
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.line_no,
        be.listing_id,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.sku_code,
        be.child_sku_code AS source_sku_code,
        be.composition_qty AS sku_multiplier,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.child_sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Actually, we need to explode models to components. Use u_explosion which has pre-computed quantities.
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        stm.order_id,
        stm.order_date,
        stm.line_no,
        stm.listing_id,
        stm.order_line_qty,
        stm.sku_code,
        stm.source_sku_code,
        stm.sku_multiplier,
        stm.model_code,
        stm.model_qty,
        ue.item_kind,
        ue.item_code,
        ue.qty AS component_qty_per_model
    FROM sku_to_model stm
    JOIN u_explosion ue ON stm.model_code = ue.root_code 
        AND ue.root_kind = 'model'
        AND ue.item_kind = 'component'
        AND ue.valid_from <= stm.order_date 
        AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR stm.order_date <= ue.valid_to)
),

        mc.order_date,
        mc.line_no,
        mc.listing_id,
        mc.item_code AS component_code,
        mc.order_line_qty * mc.sku_multiplier * mc.model_qty * mc.component_qty_per_model AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc

    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- Order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM completed_orders co
    JOIN order_line ol ON co.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
),

-- For non-bundle SKUs: explode to models using u_composition directly (sku -> model)
-- For bundle SKUs: first explode to item SKUs, then those to models
-- We need to handle the composition chain: sku -> [sku* for bundles] -> model -> component* -> part

-- Step 1: Get all SKU-to-model mappings with quantities, valid on order date
-- For non-bundle SKUs: direct sku->model composition
-- For bundle SKUs: need to go through item SKUs

-- First, get direct sku->model or sku->sku (bundle) compositions valid on date
sku_compositions AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.order_qty,
        ol.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        ol.is_bundle,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.qty AS comp_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_code = ol.sku_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= ol.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- For bundles, we need to recursively expand; for non-bundles, child_kind should be 'model'
-- Expand bundle SKUs: recursively follow sku->sku edges until we reach models
recursive_sku_expand AS (
    -- Base: all sku compositions
    SELECT 
        sc.order_id,
        sc.order_date,
        sc.order_qty,
        sc.root_sku_code,
        sc.child_code,
        sc.child_kind,
        sc.comp_qty,
        1 AS depth
    FROM sku_compositions sc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: if child is still a sku, expand further
    SELECT 
        rse.order_id,
        rse.order_date,
        rse.order_qty,
        rse.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.child_kind,
        rse.comp_qty * uc.qty AS comp_qty,
        rse.depth + 1
    FROM recursive_sku_expand rse
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_code = rse.child_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND rse.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= rse.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR rse.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Get final model-level quantities for each root order line
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        rse.order_id,
        rse.order_date,
        rse.order_qty,
        rse.root_sku_code,
        rse.child_code AS model_code,
        rse.comp_qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM recursive_sku_expand rse
    WHERE rse.child_kind = 'model'
),

-- Now explode models to all components using u_explosion
model_explosion AS (
    SELECT 
        stm.order_id,
        stm.order_date,
        stm.order_qty,
        stm.root_sku_code,
        stm.model_code,
        stm.model_qty_per_sku,
        ue.item_code AS component_code,
        ue.qty AS component_qty_per_model
    FROM sku_to_model stm
    JOIN u_explosion ue 
        ON ue.root_code = stm.model_code 
        AND ue.root_kind = 'model'
        AND ue.item_kind = 'component'
        AND ue.valid_from <= stm.order_date 
        AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR stm.order_date <= ue.valid_to)
),

-- Calculate total component quantity per order line
component_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        me.order_id,
        me.order_date,
        me.root_sku_code,
        me.component_code,
        me.order_qty * me.model_qty_per_sku * me.component_qty_per_model AS total_component_qty
    FROM model_explosion me
),

-- Sum up for the specific part
part_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(ct.total_component_qty) AS total_consumed
    FROM component_totals ct
    JOIN component c ON ct.component_code = c.component_code
    WHERE c.component_code = 'FAS-548-WAL-00203'
      AND c.is_assembly = false
)

SELECT COALESCE(total_consumed, 0) AS total_consumed FROM part_consumption

WITH RECURSIVE

    -- Recursive case: follow assembly components down to parts
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,

    FROM model_parts mp
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = mp.child_kind AND c.parent_code = mp.child_code

    WHERE mp.child_kind = 'component'

            ELSE LEAST(me.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM model_explosion me

    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2024-06-10'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2024-06-10')
      AND GREATEST(me.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= DATE '2024-06-10'
      AND (CASE 
               WHEN me.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN me.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(me.valid_to, c.valid_to)

               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN me.valid_to

)
